requirements.code_semantic: Need to search by code semantics

requirements.compact_visual_reranker: Must be less than 2 GB for image-text optimized weights

requirements.linked_file_copy: Need to obtain the original files of the paired Macs

lfm-fast.name: Liquid AI LFM3-1.7B BF16
lfm-fast.strength: Permanent lightweight model. Can provide structured fields and a short summary that match the original text word for word.
lfm-fast.tradeoff: For fields with ambiguity or still lacking sources, check the original text.

license.name: LFM Open License 1.0 – Commercial use requires checking the revenue threshold

lfm-vision.name: Liquid AI LFM3-VL-2B BF16
lfm-vision.strength: Answer the questions in the screenshot or image.
lfm-vision.tradeoff: MCP reads explicitly cached static PNG/JPEG. The original coordinates and structure are handed over to Vision OCR.

license.name: LFM Open License 1.0 – Commercial use requires checking the revenue threshold

lfm-tools.name: Liquid AI LFM2.5-8B-A1B Q8_0
lfm-tools.strength: Can generate tool names and parameters based on the tool description provided by the caller.
lfm-tools.tradeoff: The caller parses and validates parameters, and is responsible for the execution permissions of each tool.

license.name: LFM Open License 1.0 – Commercial use requires checking the revenue threshold

lfm-tools.evidence_note: The machine completed two round trips of inventory tool parameters and results, returning the expected inventory of 37.

lfm-reason.name: Liquid AI LFM2.5-24B-A2B Q8_0
lfm-reason.strength: Can be used for independent review, or for testing local providers of isolated Codex or Claude Code.
lfm-reason.tradeoff: Cold loading and unified memory overhead are high. First, use synthetic samples to test output and tool compatibility.

license.name: LFM Open License 1.0 – Commercial use requires checking the revenue threshold

lfm-reason.evidence_note: Through 1 GB discrepancy review, tool result completion, and local file reading for Codex and Claude Code.

lfm-fast-q4.name: Liquid AI LFM3-1.7B Q4_K_M
lfm-fast-q4.strength: The smaller GGUF file from the same family can be compared with BF16.
lfm-fast-q4.tradeoff: This deployment option still includes persistent BF16. Compare the quantified fields and summary quality by task.

license.name: LFM Open License 1.0 – Commercial use requires checking the revenue threshold

lfm-reason-q4.name: Liquid AI LFM2.5-24B-A2B Q4_K_M
lfm-reason-q4.strength: Low-memory review candidate from the same family. Can be directly compared with Q8.
lfm-reason-q4.tradeoff: Compare the facts and original citations using the same review sample.

license.name: LFM Open License 1.0 – Commercial use requires checking the revenue threshold

lfm-reason-q4.evidence_note: Rechecked using the same synthetic material as Q8, both provided the source numbers and a 1 GB discrepancy. More complex rechecks and tool behaviors still need to be compared.

pdfkit.name: Apple PDFKit
pdfkit.strength: Directly extract the text and page numbers from the existing PDF.
pdfkit.tradeoff: PDF is most suitable when there are available text layers. Complex reading sequences, table coordinates, and scanned images need to be reviewed.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

pdfkit.evidence_note: This route assumes that the text layer is actually read using PDFKit.

vision.name: Apple Vision OCR / Document Recognition
vision.strength: No additional weight required for download. Supports scanning pages, text lines, coordinates, and detected tables.
vision.tradeoff: Complex formulas, merged cells, or multi-column reading order require viewing the original page. No separate paragraph tree is provided.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

paddle.name: PaddleOCR-VL 1.6 + PP-DocLayoutV3
paddle.strength: Combination of layout detection and region recognition. Returns table, formula candidates, Markdown, and region positions.
paddle.tradeoff: Two additional operating environments and models need to be installed. Processing is done per page, and cross-page tables require separate concatenation.

license.name: Apache-2.0

paddle.evidence_note: On the composite page with summation and radical integration, return the LaTeX and region coordinates of the two formulas.

minicpm.name: MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 8-bit (MLX)
minicpm.strength: Single-page image to Markdown, as the second recognition model for difficult pages.
minicpm.tradeoff: This integration directly recognizes the entire page image. No block-level coordinates are output, and it does not include layout detection from official SDKs.

license.name: Apache-2.0

minicpm.evidence_note: The synthesis page with summation and radical integration returns two formulas and their corresponding numbers.

jev.name: MiniCPM-OCR Jev 8-bit (MLX)
jev.strength: Independently verify the consistency of the OCR text, original cropping, and text rendering.
jev.tradeoff: Need the original image and candidate rendered images from the same region. Samples need to be labeled according to document types for calibration, and scores are used for screening and review.

license.name: Apache-2.0

prerequisites: Provide the original crop, candidate text, and an image of the rendered candidate.
jev.evidence_note: Examples of errors using OpenBMB have been called via scoring, and the document threshold has not been calibrated.

barcodes.name: Apple Vision Barcode Detection
barcodes.strength: Directly return the barcode type, value, confidence, and coordinates on the photo or PDF page.
barcodes.tradeoff: The output is the data from the input. The application must not automatically open encoded links.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

apple-speech.name: Apple SpeechTranscriber
apple-speech.strength: Low-maintenance file transcription; Chinese and English resources are managed by the system.
apple-speech.tradeoff: Some time is currently available, but an anonymous speaker tag is missing. The target locale needs to be prepared first.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

moss.name: MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize 8-bit (MLX)
moss.strength: One-step output includes multiple transcriptions, time intervals, and anonymous speech numbers.
moss.tradeoff: The number is valid only for this recording. Long recordings, overlapping speeches, and generated length need to be checked. The maximum input time for this MCP is 30 minutes.

license.name: Apache-2.0

qwen-asr.name: Qwen3-ASR 0.6B 8-bit + ForcedAligner (MLX)
qwen-asr.strength: Suitable for transcriptions that require word or language unit timestamps, using the original audio for alignment.
qwen-asr.tradeoff: This path has no speaker attribution. Non-WAV formats may require ffmpeg. Language alignment has independent restrictions.

license.name: Apache-2.0

qwen-large.name: Qwen3-ASR 1.7B 8-bit + ForcedAligner (MLX)
qwen-large.strength: Using the 1.7B recognizer specified in the research, reusing the same word-level time interface.
qwen-large.tradeoff: The weight ratio is 0.6B. First, perform a comparison transcription using the target accent and terms, which takes time. This path has no speaker labels.

license.name: Apache-2.0

qwen-align.name: Qwen3-ForcedAligner 0.6B (MLX)
qwen-align.strength: Allocate time for aligning the revised text, and you can then go back to checking the audio word by word or language unit by unit.
qwen-align.tradeoff: Use the same original recording and correct language. Alignment will not correct typos. The maximum duration for a single session is 120 seconds.

license.name: Apache-2.0

speech-detector.name: Apple SpeechDetector
speech-detector.strength: Uses VAD within SpeechAnalyzer to reduce transcription power consumption.
speech-detector.tradeoff: Apple documentation states that the current result stream is only used for error reporting, and the local file mode does not output any audio segments.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

speech-detector.evidence_note: The local file mode returns an empty observation, which is consistent with Apple’s description of the current API.

silero-vad.name: Silero VAD 6.2.2 ONNX
silero-vad.strength: Locate speech with a step of 32 milliseconds on the CPU, without requiring a language or translation model. The weight is approximately 1.25 MB.
silero-vad.tradeoff: FFmpeg is required. When detecting whisper in sounds or strong noise less than 250 milliseconds, it needs to refer to the original audio.

license.name: MIT

silero-vad.evidence_note: Return four speech segments with known start and end silence samples, and an empty array for pure silence.

qwen-stream.name: Qwen3-ASR MLX Streaming CLI
qwen-stream.strength: Receive continuous PCM from stdin. Each audio block outputs a provisional text and a stable prefix. The final version is output when EOF is reached.
qwen-stream.tradeoff: The input must be a 16 kHz mono PCM signal provided by the local audio source. Microphone capture also requires macOS authorization, and the delay is affected by the device and block length.

license.name: Apache-2.0

qwen-stream.evidence_note: Both real-time PCM and built-in Mac microphones work. The microphone returns the intermediate text every 1 second, and the synthesized number appears before the final version.

qwen-stream-replay.name: Qwen3-ASR Streaming Replay
qwen-stream-replay.strength: Split the existing audio playback into continuous blocks, returning some text, a stable prefix, and the number of rollbacks.
qwen-stream-replay.tradeoff: MCP returns the timeline all at once after the request ends. For input while receiving, use the PCM pipeline of bin/stream-asr.

license.name: Apache-2.0

qwen-stream-replay.evidence_note: Replaying the synthetic recording returned five partial transcripts, two revisions, and a complete final transcript.

omni.name: Omni / Jina v5 Omni Small
omni.strength: The application has provided a local multimodal index. MCP calls the local Unix socket.
omni.tradeoff: Index is a candidate clue. Only the explicitly selected directories are indexed. The licensing of code and weights is different.

license.name: Apache-2.0 code and CC BY-NC 4.0 weights

prerequisites: Download the pinned weights with the installer, then index the selected folder with the Omni CLI.
omni.evidence_note: Both clients verified the synthesized text. The PDF was found on page 2. Audio and video were found in the files. The semantic query did not return a timestamp for both short materials.

digup.name: DigUp / EmbeddingGemma 2 740M
digup.strength: Apache weight integrated text, image, audio, and video search, supports precise keywords.
digup.tradeoff: Create an index for each allowed directory first. Strict thresholds may miss some rewriting queries in small datasets. You can lower the threshold to retrieve candidates, and then check the original file.

license.name: MIT CLI and Apache-2.0 weights

digup.evidence_note: The synthesized text, screenshots, page 2 of the PDF, audio and video clips, and code lines were identified. Both clients received the same audio segment.

omni-pairing.name: Omni paired Mac search
omni-pairing.strength: Differentiate each Mac by its purpose, and you can find local files across linked devices.
omni-pairing.tradeoff: It needs to be paired first, and an index for sharing must be set between both parties. MCP returns the path based on configuration filtering. The entity dual machine needs verification. Skipped in this phase.

license.name: Apache-2.0 code and CC BY-NC 4.0 weights

omni-pairing.evidence_note: Two isolated instances on the same Mac are paired, indexed, verified, and returned offline. Both Codex and offline Claude Code obtain remote markers and line numbers.
prerequisites: Use two pairable Macs and verify each against approved test material.

omni-linked-copy.name: Omni paired Mac file retrieval
omni-linked-copy.strength: After re-checking the hit, write the file to the designated local directory. Return the path, byte count, and SHA-256.
omni-linked-copy.tradeoff: The endpoint must allow reading files, and the matching results must contain metadata no larger than 16 MiB. The entity dual-machine setup needs verification. This stage is skipped.

license.name: Apache-2.0 code and CC BY-NC 4.0 weights

omni-linked-copy.evidence_note: Two real isolated instances on the same Mac are encrypted and paired. Both Codex and offline Claude Code obtain byte-identical copies.

spotlight.name: Apple Spotlight File Name Search
spotlight.strength: Using the system’s existing metadata index, no vectors need to be generated.
spotlight.tradeoff: The coverage depends on the directory, system settings, and the current index status.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

spotlight.evidence_note: The local CLI found known filenames in the synthetic fixture directory.

core-spotlight.name: Apple SpotlightSearchTool App Index
core-spotlight.strength: The device model calls the system search tool to retrieve the specified App notes, returning independent original matches. It can be rewritten as short keywords first.
core-spotlight.tradeoff: Need Apple Intelligence to process a group of short notes at a time.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

core-spotlight.evidence_note: Found the original text by searching the title of the self-compiled note. Descriptive issues were identified by changing keywords to match the same note.

core-spotlight-semantic.name: Apple Core Spotlight Semantic Search
core-spotlight-semantic.strength: Use CSUserQuery’s system lexical and semantic ranking to retrieve specified short notes, and directly return the original text.
core-spotlight-semantic.tradeoff: Synonym coverage varies depending on the query and system language, and related notes may be missed.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

core-spotlight-semantic.evidence_note: Pastries made with tree nuts – original term. Individual word search for the same query did not return any results. Synonym search for “marine mammals” still misses seals.

jina-grep.name: Jina Code Embeddings 0.5B MLX
jina-grep.strength: Sort the specified source file segments based on behavior and return line numbers, without indices.
jina-grep.tradeoff: Suitable for a small number of defined files. For repeated searches across the entire warehouse, use DigUp. For known identifiers, use rg or the language server.

license.name: Jina 0.5B MLX weights CC BY-NC 4.0

jina-grep.evidence_note: In the behavior queries of the five synthesized files, both clients prefer line 1–3 of retries.py.

qwen-reranker.name: Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B
qwen-reranker.strength: Perform a second-stage relevance scoring on the recalled candidate image-text pages.
qwen-reranker.tradeoff: Need the first round candidates and the original page images. Each candidate must be scored, and the cost increases with the number of candidates.

license.name: Apache-2.0

qwen-reranker.evidence_note: Scan the PDF, place the 2nd page at the beginning on both ends, and use a mix of cat images, barcode images, and irrelevant text for verification.

qwen-reranker-4bit.name: Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B MLX 4-bit
qwen-reranker-4bit.strength: Weight: 1.78 GB, using the same image-text candidate interface and official rating template.
qwen-reranker-4bit.tradeoff: The samples in both groups were chosen to be consistent with BF16, and the scores were significantly lower. After switching to the quantitative version, the threshold needs to be recalibrated.

license.name: Apache-2.0

qwen-reranker-4bit.evidence_note: Scanning the PDF, page 2 and the cat image both remain at the top in their respective tests.

apple-translation.name: Apple Translation
apple-translation.strength: System management language package. No additional machine learning runtime is needed for short text or batch translation.
apple-translation.tradeoff: Only handle language pairs supported by the system and already installed. No custom glossary.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

apple-translation.evidence_note: This machine verifies batch output using installed English and Simplified Chinese language resources.

hy-mt.name: Tencent Hy-MT2 1.8B 8-bit (MLX)
hy-mt.strength: Line by line translation, following the glossary guidelines. Suitable for reviewing large amounts of text processed in small batches.
hy-mt.tradeoff: Terminology is a hint. Actual hits need to be verified. Cross-segment consistency and subtitle timeline are maintained by the caller. 7B is available in the upstream option.

license.name: Apache-2.0

hy-mt.evidence_note: The device has verified the English-to-Simplified Chinese translation and term suggestions.

natural-language.name: Apple Natural Language
natural-language.strength: Rapid language recognition, tokenization, part of speech, and built-in person, place, and organization tags.
natural-language.tradeoff: The output range is limited by the system-supported languages and tag ranges. Custom fields are processed using specialized extraction tools.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

apple-fm-python.name: Apple Foundation Models Python SDK
apple-fm-python.strength: The system device model determines which key to read, and Python callbacks read the local records and return the original, verifiable value. Python can also directly define custom tools.
apple-fm-python.tradeoff: Depends on Apple Intelligence and Apple SDK. The native 26.5 SDK path uses text, tool callbacks, and structured output. Image attachments require 27 SDK.

license.name: Apache-2.0 Python SDK and Apple software terms for the system model

apple-fm-python.evidence_note: The device model called the Python tool using the exact key, and read the number from the synthesis record.

apple-fm-image.name: Apple Foundation Models Native Image Q&A
apple-fm-image.strength: The device model directly receives image pixels and issues, suitable for single queries regarding color, objects, and spatial relationships.
apple-fm-image.tradeoff: Requires macOS 27, bindings built with 27 SDK, and Apple Intelligence. Use Vision OCR for word-for-word reliable text and coordinates.

license.name: Apache-2.0 Python SDK and Apple software terms for the system model

apple-fm-image.evidence_note: The native ImageAttachment recognizes two text-free images as a green circle in the upper left and a green triangle in the upper left, respectively.

foundation-models.name: Apple Foundation Models Short Text Q&A
foundation-models.strength: The system model performs focused Q&A, summarization, or snippet filtering on short materials.
foundation-models.tradeoff: Apple Intelligence must be enabled. Currently, MCP provides free response to short texts.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

foundation-structured.name: Apple Foundation Models Structured Generation
foundation-structured.strength: Using Swift dynamic schema, valid fields are extracted from short text. Fields that are omitted or output as blank by the model return null. No third-party weights need to be downloaded.
foundation-structured.tradeoff: Apple Intelligence must be enabled. Up to eight string fields are required. Phrases like “to be determined” may be returned as is, and confirmed values need to be verified.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

foundation-structured.evidence_note: On macOS 27.2.1, dynamic schema with Swift yields the expected English text and empty fields.

gliner.name: GLiNER2.5 multi-v1 287M
gliner.strength: Define entity types using custom tags, locate the original spans in bulk, and return confidence scores.
gliner.tradeoff: This tool calls entity extraction. Relationship extraction is handled by the upstream API. Thresholds and recall need to be calibrated using target data.

license.name: Apache-2.0

gliner.evidence_note: English, Chinese, and mixed-language samples verify names, cities, and text range. Both Codex and Claude Code used Chinese samples.

privacy-filter.name: OpenAI Privacy Filter
privacy-filter.strength: Mark and replace common sensitive text fields locally, and provide the original location for review.
privacy-filter.tradeoff: There are missed detections and out-of-range information. Sensitive text is processed via the local CLI, and the authorization decision for any output segments is retained.

license.name: Apache-2.0

privacy-filter.evidence_note: Both Offline Codex and Offline Claude Code replace synthesized names, dates, emails, and phone numbers with local word lists and weights. Another example missed a name.

clef.name: Cloudflare Clef-Flash 9B MLX 4-bit
clef.strength: The same reasoning is used for binary judgments, multiple-choice questions, and ordered scoring on text or images.
clef.tradeoff: Verify the misclassification rate and thresholds for each task. Images and text will occupy the same context.

license.name: Original model and MLX 4-bit weights Apache-2.0

talknet.name: TalkNet-ASD PyTorch/MPS
talknet.strength: Associate the synchronized audio tracks with the speaker tracks in the video, and output the time intervals, face boxes, and annotated videos.
talknet.tradeoff: 360° video needs to be projected first. Side profiles, off-screen speech, and audio-video misalignment can affect the result.

license.name: MIT code. TalkSet and S3FD weight terms are unconfirmed.

talknet.evidence_note: In the first 5 seconds of the upstream multi-person demonstration video, the outputs on the CPU and MPS are consistent, and both clients report the same active face trajectory.

sam3.name: Segment Anything 3 MLX
sam3.strength: Use text to locate objects, returning PNG masks, boxes, or time-based short video cross-frame associations for each object.
sam3.tradeoff: Frame-crossing numbers are determined by frame overlap relationships. Occlusion, similar targets, and shot transitions need to be reviewed. There are specific provisions for Meta weights.

license.name: SAM License

sam3.evidence_note: After correcting the tokenizer, both cats generated full-resolution masks. The main vehicle in the synthesized mobile street view maintains the same ID at all four sampling points.

sam-audio.name: SAM Audio small MLX
sam-audio.strength: Separate the target and residual two 48 kHz WAV files based on voice description from the short recording.
sam-audio.tradeoff: Need to review crosstalk, distortion, and missing separation. The current project interface can handle short segments of up to 30 seconds.

license.name: SAM Audio License, verify usage and model acquisition conditions

sam-audio.evidence_note: 5 seconds of voice plus a 440 Hz synthetic bass, with the bass amplitude in the target track reduced to about 2.1% of the input. Both clients obtained two WAV files.

apple-tts.name: macOS Speech Synthesis
apple-tts.strength: Generate native WAV files using installed system sounds directly, with support for specifying sounds and speeds.
apple-tts.tradeoff: Tone and language depend on system resources. Try out dialogue tone control, mixed speech, and proper pronunciation of special names.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

apple-tts.evidence_note: In macOS 27.2.1, both Samantha and Tingting actually generate 22.05 kHz PCM WAV.

kokoro.name: Kokoro 82M on MLX Audio
kokoro.strength: Fixed Chinese and English sound profiles and language front-end, generates 24 kHz PCM WAV, easy to generate repeatedly.
kokoro.tradeoff: Also install MLX, dictionary, and timbre. Mixed languages, special terms, and long texts need to be reviewed according to the target text.

license.name: Apache-2.0

kokoro.evidence_note: af_heart and zf_xiaobei both generate 24 kHz PCM WAV samples, which are reviewed by native ASR.

swiftvr.name: SwiftVR 5B via MLX-Gen
swiftvr.strength: Single-step video repair at the original resolution. The short film acceptance retained the number of frames, frame rate, and available audio tracks.
swiftvr.tradeoff: It will change the image details. SSIM decreased in both comparisons with clean references, and it needs to be evaluated based on the material.

license.name: SwiftVR Research License 1.0

swiftvr.evidence_note: 320 × 192, 9 frames, 8 fps test clip output retains audio tracks and 1.125 seconds in length.

seedvr2.name: SeedVR2-3B MLX 8-bit
seedvr2.strength: You can repair and zoom in on static images or videos on the same local model, while preserving frame rate, duration, and audio tracks for test segments.
seedvr2.tradeoff: For 2x zoom in the video, the high-memory mode at the upstream level must be explicitly enabled. The original-size test and the referenced SSIM are lower than the input.

license.name: MLX-Gen MIT, SeedVR2-3B weights Apache-2.0

upscale-video.setup_note: To enable video scaling, set allow_high_memory=true explicitly. For a 320 × 192 resolution with 9 frames, the MLX peak value is 52.71 GB. Try running a short video first.

seedvr2.evidence_note: 320 × 192 static image and the audio short clip were successfully enlarged to 640 × 384. The MLX peak for 9-frame video is approximately 52.7 GB.

apple-video-upscale.name: Apple VideoToolbox Low-Latency Super Resolution
apple-video-upscale.strength: The VideoToolbox in the system calls for frame-by-frame zooming. The local test run supports 2x and 4x zooming for low-resolution videos.
apple-video-upscale.tradeoff: The scaling factor depends on the device and pixel size. This entry processes SDR, and outputs H.264 and AAC.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

apple-video-upscale.evidence_note: 320 × 192 short video is output as 1280 × 768, 9 frames, and one audio track at 2x and 4x resolutions. The 1920 × 1080 resolution is not available on this Mac.

timesfm.name: TimesFM 3.0 330M
timesfm.strength: Google’s MLX backend supports multiple variables, only historical and known future covariates, and outputs three percentiles.
timesfm.tradeoff: This device’s weight limits are non-commercial and non-production. The error ordering with Chronos-2 varies depending on the test sequence.

license.name: TimesFM 3.0 weights for noncommercial, nonproduction use

timesfm.evidence_note: Two composite targets and two covariates are used to output an eight-step ordered quantile. Both clients return the same short sample results.

chronos.name: Chronos-2 120M
chronos.strength: On the CPU, generate 0.1, 0.5, and 0.9 percentile predictions from same-frequency targets and optional covariates, along with the most recent observation baseline.
chronos.tradeoff: Error and interval coverage rates need to be verified using independent time windows.

license.name: Apache-2.0

chronos.evidence_note: The CPU uses two synthesized targets and known future covariates to produce a six-step prediction. The residual MAE of the flow sequence is 0.359, and the recent value baseline is 8.337, which is only applicable to this sample.

depth-anything.name: Depth Anything V2 Small Core ML
depth-anything.strength: The dense relative depth obtained from a single image is suitable for occlusion and sequential screening.
depth-anything.tradeoff: No direct metric distances or robot coordinates provided. Reflecting and transparent objects need to be checked.

license.name: Small model Apache-2.0

depth-anything.evidence_note: This machine’s Core ML compilation is successful. On the public street view, the order of nearby cars, buses, and distant towers matches expectations. Both clients have been tested in real use.

lean-kernel.name: Lean 4.9 Kernel and Axiom Audit
lean-kernel.strength: Check the existing code, verify the specified proposition types, and list both direct and indirect used axioms.
lean-kernel.tradeoff: The project includes the Lean 4.9 standard library. The project-specific mathlib version is run via Lake in this project.

license.name: Lean 4 Apache-2.0

lean-kernel.evidence_note: Valid acceptance proof, sorry, custom axioms and propositions do not match.

goedel.name: Goedel-Prover-V2 8B Q4_K_M + Lean
goedel.strength: Generate Lean code using the local GGUF, and independently replay proofs to verify given propositions and axioms.
goedel.tradeoff: The model may provide incorrect or incomplete candidates. To use Mathlib, a fixed version that matches is required to be installed.

license.name: 8B GGUF, Lean and mathlib Apache-2.0, llama.cpp MIT

goedel.evidence_note: Both the union exchange and the generation results of Mathlib integer square identities pass through independent types, axioms, and kernel checks.

smolvla.name: SmolVLA / LeRobot Offline Action Preview
smolvla.strength: Using recorded camera images, six-dimensional joint states, and text, generate candidate action sequences from a Mac CPU or GPU.
smolvla.tradeoff: Reflected in the policy output of the specified camera and normalized space. The new robotic arm and tasks require teaching, calibration, and corresponding evaluation.

license.name: Apache-2.0

smolvla.evidence_note: The dual-camera images and joint states in the official SO100 example are generated as 50 × 6 movements in both CPU and MPS.

smolvla-preflight.name: LeRobot SO-100 / SO-101 preflight
smolvla-preflight.strength: Check serial port enumeration, native motor drive, six-axis model, and calibration metadata.
smolvla-preflight.tradeoff: Checking is completed during the reading and enumeration stages. The camera image, hardware calibration, and task results need to be confirmed on-site.

license.name: Apache-2.0

smolvla-preflight.evidence_note: Fixed: LeRobot can be loaded during runtime. The current Mac does not detect the USB serial port specified for testing.

smolvla-rollout.name: SmolVLA / LeRobot
smolvla-rollout.strength: Convert the camera images, robot status, and commands into strategic actions, and you can replay them offline first.
smolvla-rollout.tradeoff: Cross-hardware and motion space need to be adapted. First, verify the strategy actions via playback or simulation. Real device needs validation. Skip this stage for now.

license.name: Apache-2.0

prerequisites: A live rollout requires a compatible arm, cameras, calibration, and task-specific demonstrations.

apple-foreground.name: Apple Vision foreground segmentation
apple-foreground.strength: Automatically identify the foreground of the image and output a transparent PNG at original size, available with native tool installation.
apple-foreground.tradeoff: Each image combines all foreground instances. Select SAM3 when separating according to object text instructions.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

apple-foreground.evidence_note: The sample with two cats returned a 640 × 480 RGBA image with a transparent background and opaque foreground.

vision-media.name: Apple Vision Image and Video Analysis
vision-media.strength: Evaluate the category and appearance scores for a single image or extracted video frame, or compare the feature distances between two images.
vision-media.tradeoff: The image similarity threshold needs to be calibrated according to the material. Image cutting, optical flow, and pose estimation use independent APIs.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

vision-media.evidence_note: In macOS 27.2.1, the image categories and appearance scores were measured. The distance for the same image is 0, while the distance for different images is greater than 0.

sound-analysis.name: Apple Sound Analysis
sound-analysis.strength: Output events and intervals of applause, laughter, or preset sound types.
sound-analysis.tradeoff: The classifier vocabulary is related to the scenario. There are independent tools for speech activity, sound source separation, and text recognition.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

sound-analysis.evidence_note: macOS 27.2.1 generates 6 speech time windows with confidence levels for synthetic speech.

shortcuts.name: macOS Shortcuts Text and Image Actions
shortcuts.strength: The configured quick commands can be invoked using commands. The local device model receives text, and OCR quick commands can also receive explicitly provided screenshots.
shortcuts.tradeoff: Action combinations and permissions are determined by quick commands.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

shortcuts.evidence_note: Both manual text and image processing routes have been successfully implemented. Image OCR identified NATIVE-482 in the actual test file.

screenshot-folder.name: macOS Directory Events + Vision Screenshot OCR
screenshot-folder.strength: Read new screenshots of system files events from the specified directory, and use Apple Vision to return the original text and location.
screenshot-folder.tradeoff: The upstream needs to capture and publish the completed image first. The CLI can process continuously, while MCP waits for a file only once.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

screenshot-folder.evidence_note: After the screenshot of the application test window is posted to the specified directory, both clients are marked with NATIVE-482 via the new file event.

shortcuts-folder.name: macOS Shortcuts Folder Automation
shortcuts-folder.strength: Submit the new file to Extract Text from Image, and save the text in the specified directory.
shortcuts-folder.tradeoff: It needs to be manually configured in Shortcuts, and the first trigger may be delayed. The Agent can read the output file.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

shortcuts-folder.evidence_note: On macOS 27.2.1, the previous two automated runs of Folder completed and OCR was saved. The system logged WFFolderTrigger.

shortcuts-screenshot.name: macOS Shortcuts System Screenshot Event
shortcuts-screenshot.strength: When the system saves a window screenshot to a file, Shortcuts can directly trigger the workflow.
shortcuts-screenshot.tradeoff: The Shortcuts interface supports triggering based on destination type, which requires manual configuration. Directory isolation and direct return to OCR are available when directory monitoring is required.

license.name: macOS framework under Apple software terms

shortcuts-screenshot.evidence_note: After the physical keyboard captures the composite window, WFScreenshotTrigger initiates a background workflow and saves a fixed marker. The Vision MCP of the project reads back the test number of the same screenshot.

core-ml.name: Apple Core ML Third-Party Model Runtime
core-ml.strength: Directly read the input/output structure of the self-contained model, and perform image, scalar, short string, and tensor inference.
core-ml.tradeoff: Actual operator scheduling and performance depend on the model and device. Sequences, states, and custom layers need to be tailored specifically.

license.name: System framework terms and selected model licenses are checked separately

core-ml.evidence_note: Core ML compiles and runs the custom ReLU tensor model and Apple Deep Model package.
